title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 064
review_goal: Differentiate grok, group, and hair variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Circular swirl ring with one diagonal slash line cutting across the center
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a curved circular mark cut by a diagonal slash line.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the square grok mark when the outer border should stay box shaped.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot turns the grok symbol into a broken ring shape crossed by one slash.

items.depicts_observation: Two person busts with one large head left and one smaller head right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a two person group with one main bust and one secondary bust.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the three person group when a third head should appear above the center.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows two heads and two bust shapes with the larger person on the left.

items.depicts_observation: Three person busts with one centered head above two smaller side heads
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a three person group with one centered main figure and two side figures.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the two person group when only one side companion should appear.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds a third centered head above the left and right companion heads.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded hair silhouette with one centered face opening and two lower locks
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a broad hairstyle framing a centered face opening.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the single hair lock icon when the shape should not frame a full face opening.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot outlines a full hairstyle wrapping around a centered face space.

items.depicts_observation: Single curved hair lock with one inner loop centered inside the outline
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a single hair strand or lock instead of a full hairstyle silhouette.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the full hair silhouette when the icon should frame a face opening.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot reduces the hairstyle to one curved lock with a looped inner opening.
